descriptions.text: Platinum Sharpening Stone. Warning: This item has a short shelf life. Apply this to any spiked offensive weapon to receive the following buffs. Plus (2 x current level)% damage to all attacks. Plus 1 to all current stat buffs. Does not add new buffs if they do not exist. It also makes the weapon look extra oily and mean looking. In other words, the weapon’s appearance may change. But only a little.

recap.text: Carl's last box, the platinum quest box from saving Hump Town, holds 5,000 gold coins, twenty healing scrolls and a little black rock. Mordecai is pleased and says the rock is for the gauntlet and must be used now. Carl forms the gauntlet and rubs the stone along its spikes. The whole gauntlet glows, the spikes grow a little longer, and Carl gets one point of dexterity and one of strength.

beats.headline: The last box
beats.text: The last of Carl's boxes is the platinum quest box from saving Hump Town, and he needs something good: everything lately has been weird or not yet usable. It holds 5,000 gold coins, twenty healing scrolls and a little black rock. Mordecai is pleased. This is what he was talking about: Carl is starting to get items that enhance the ones he already has. It is for the gauntlet, he says, and Carl has to use it now.
beats.gist: Carl opens his last box and finds a little black rock meant for his gauntlet.

beats.headline: Rubbed into the spikes
beats.text: The stone has a short shelf life, so it cannot wait. Carl forms his gauntlet and rubs the rock along the spikes. The whole thing glows, and the spikes themselves grow a little longer. With the gauntlet formed, he gets an extra point of dexterity and another of strength. Then he turns to the paper and inkwell from his other box while Katia opens her platinum one.
beats.gist: Carl rubs the Platinum Sharpening Stone along his gauntlet's spikes, lengthening them and raising his dexterity and strength.
